title: STEAP4-linked immune changes were examined in myocardial-infarction and lung-cancer comorbidity
summary: Integrated patient-data analyses associated STEAP4 with immune dysregulation in myocardial-infarction and non-small-cell lung-cancer comorbidity. Follow-up experiments in a mouse comorbidity model and cell assays examined STEAP4 perturbation; the findings are preclinical and do not establish a human treatment.
ai_technology: Machine-learning-assisted transcriptomic analysis identified STEAP4; experimental perturbation was assessed in cellular and mouse models.
organization: Shanghai Chest Hospital; Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine

evidence.tested: The study combined transcriptomic analyses with a myocardial-infarction/NSCLC mouse model and cellular assays; STEAP4 perturbation was associated with changes in cardiac function, fibrosis, tumor growth and immune measures.
evidence.unknown: Bioinformatic and preclinical evidence; no clinical intervention or human therapeutic benefit established.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning-assisted transcriptomic analysis identified STEAP4; experimental perturbation was assessed in cellular and mouse models.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
